Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for NABFINS Customer Service Officer (CSO) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the NABFINS recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the NABFINS recruitment is Customer Service Officer (CSO).

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the Customer Service Officer (CSO) post?
faq.answer: The educational qualification required is PUC/10+2 completed.

faq.question: Q4. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 09 August 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What are the states where this recruitment is open?
faq.answer: This recruitment is open for candidates in Tamil Nadu & Bihar.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry original documents and self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and any other relevant documents.

faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview.
